segments.he: וְאִם לַגּוֹרֶן בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מָנֶה – אָסוּר. אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן: טַרְשָׁא שְׁרֵי.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If the field owner said: «But if» you wait and pay me «at» the time of «the harvest,» the field is yours «for twelve hundred» dinars, this is «prohibited. Rav Naḥman said: Tacit interest [tarsha]» is «permitted.» In other words, one may make a contract for a sale with a later payment date at an increased price, as long as he does not specify that the higher price is due to the delay but merely states a price and a date.

moves.cueHe: ואם לגורן בשנים עשר מנה – אסור

moves.about: tacit interest (a higher price for later payment without stating the deferral) is outside the mishna's prohibition
